register.description: This register contains parameters to control the whole Mailbox system. Provided for backwards compatibility with OMAP Mailbox. Only contains the soft reset.

bitfield.description: Module Software ResetThe bit is automatically reset by the hardware. During reads, it always returns 0.It has the same effect as the hardware reset.Writing a 0 has no effect. register.description: The interrupt status register has the status for each event that may be responsible for the generation of an interrupt to the corresponding user .Software may also write 1 to a given bit to set this bit to test interrupt generation. It will activate the status bit for two cycles. This may still be masked, however. Write 0 has no effect.
